name: TendMyStore – ChatGPT & Claude for WooCommerce
author: YLabs

sections.description:
Connect WooCommerce to ChatGPT & Claude

Manage WooCommerce products, orders and stock by chat with TendMyStore in ChatGPT or Claude. This plugin helps you prepare your store locally, find the official TendMyStore assistant links, and follow the setup steps. Connection and store operations happen in the separate TendMyStore service after you authorize access.

TendMyStore adds one page under Tools > TendMyStore for administrators.

The local Store readiness checklist shows whether WooCommerce is active (and its version), the configured site address uses HTTPS, permalinks are not Plain, Application Passwords are available to the current user, and that user can manage WooCommerce. Each check includes a brief explanation or fix hint.

When you press Check readiness, the plugin also makes one bounded GET to your own site’s REST index URL, as provided by WordPress and checks for a WordPress REST index. It does not follow redirects or send cookies or credentials. No readiness results are stored or sent to TendMyStore. A successful local check does not prove the store can be reached from outside or grant anyone access.

The same page has two links to the TendMyStore app in ChatGPT and the TendMyStore connector in Claude, followed by short setup steps. You choose whether to open them and separately authorize any service connection.

This plugin has no MCP server, remote administration, analytics, tracking, settings changes, automatic connection, theme/plugin installation, scheduled jobs or front-end output. Deactivating or removing it does not disconnect a connection you separately authorized in the service.

External services

TendMyStore is a separate hosted service for working with a WooCommerce store from an AI assistant. A TendMyStore account and a ChatGPT or Claude account are needed to use that service; assistant availability can depend on the provider’s account and region. This plugin’s local readiness checks do not need a TendMyStore account.

The plugin itself sends no data to TendMyStore, OpenAI, Anthropic or another external service. Its only HTTP request is the administrator-triggered GET to this site’s own REST index. Images and styles are included locally.

The two assistant links open external sites in a new tab, without adding your store address, email, readiness results or tracking parameters:

  • ChatGPT: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ad135ee0d208191a6a2f7b82e8aae3a
  • Claude: https://claude.ai/directory/tendmystore-for-woocommerce

Opening a link makes a normal browser visit to that provider. Adding the app/connector and signing in opens the TendMyStore service. If you separately approve a store connection, the hosted service uses that authorization to access store data for the requests you make in your assistant. Those later service interactions are not performed by this plugin. Review the service policies before connecting.

  • TendMyStore: https://tendmystore.com/
  • TendMyStore privacy: https://tendmystore.com/privacy/
  • TendMyStore terms: https://tendmystore.com/terms/
  • OpenAI privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • OpenAI terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
  • Anthropic privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Anthropic consumer terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms

ChatGPT, Claude and WooCommerce are trademarks of their respective owners. No endorsement by OpenAI, Anthropic or WooCommerce is claimed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate TendMyStore.
  2. Open Tools > TendMyStore as an administrator.
  3. Read the checklist and press Check readiness to test the site’s own REST index.
  4. Open your preferred assistant link. Sign in to ChatGPT or Claude if asked (Claude may require sign-in before showing the listing), add TendMyStore and sign in or create a TendMyStore account.
  5. Ask to connect your WooCommerce store, give its HTTPS address, and follow the service’s connection link. Approve only on your own store’s WordPress/WooCommerce screen as an administrator, then return to your chat.
sections.faq:
Does activating this plugin connect my store?

No. Connection and authorization happen separately in the assistant and hosted TendMyStore service.

Does it change my settings or install WooCommerce?

No. Fix hints are instructions for you or your administrator. The plugin changes no settings and installs no other software.

Why can the REST check fail while my shop opens normally?

The shop page and REST API are different routes. Plain permalinks, a certificate problem, a redirect, a restricted REST index or host loopback/security rules can prevent this limited unauthenticated check. It stops after one request; ask your administrator or host to investigate. Do not disable authentication protections just to pass it.

Is an Application Password required for every connection?

This checks WordPress availability only. The hosted service may offer a different supported WooCommerce authorization flow. A failed checklist item does not create, revoke or change credentials.
